description: Win back the bs-1536 accuracy loss through the Muon lr. This is the follow-up pre-registered in I042. At bs 1536 the run takes about 1/3 fewer fixed-magnitude, weight-norm-projected Muon rotations (~212 instead of ~319 steps), so the total rotation path of each filter shrank by about 33%. On the tip (the curriculum-stacked commit if the idea above is kept, else E042), change only the Muon lr for the conv filters, from 0.16 to 0.20. Momentum 0.8, NS3, projection, the schedule shape and floor, the SGD group, lookahead, augmentation and epochs all stay identical. The lr is a 0-d tensor, so nothing recompiles.
